title: Copilot Studio: makers can require human approval before an agent runs a tool
notes: claim 54: severity major on a rationale: risk rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page

claims.claim: A connector-blocking data policy prevents use of the connector rather than requesting approval to run it.
claims.quote: To prevent agent makers from using Power Platform connectors as tools in Copilot Studio agents, configure a data policy with the connectors you want to block.

claims.claim: Security > Data and privacy > Data policy > New Policy is the route to controlling which connectors can be used.
claims.quote: The Add an environment page appears. ... select the environment in the Available tab, and then select Add to policy. ... The Assign connectors page appears. ... To prevent agent makers from using the features associated with the connector, select Block.
claims.fix: Replace the UI path with 'Security > Data and privacy > Data policy > New Policy > Add an environment > Available > environment > Add to policy > Assign connectors > connector > Block'. The current path enters policy creation but omits the environment choice and connector-blocking control documented on the cited page. Apply the same replacement in the rendered table.

claims.claim: New-DlpPolicy -DisplayName <String> -EnvironmentType <String> automates the connector-blocking control.
claims.quote: The New-DlpPolicy cmdlet creates a new DLP policy for the logged in admin's tenant.
claims.fix: Replace the call with 'Add-ConnectorsToPolicy -PolicyName <policy-guid> -Classification Blocked -Connectors <connector-objects>' in Microsoft.PowerApps.Administration.PowerShell, and replace docs with https://learn.microsoft.com/powershell/module/microsoft.powerapps.administration.powershell/add-connectorstopolicy?view=pa-ps-latest. Add to the row note: 'Moves the supplied connectors into the policy's Blocked group; each connector object requires id, type and name.' The reference documents these parameters and permits Classification Blocked. Update the table and sources consistently.
